scripts.build: python3 setup.py && npm run coverage && npm run lint && echo 'Build complete!' && node tools/coverageSummary.js --print-last-summary
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:js: node tools/lint/jsFilenameStyle.js && node tools/lint/jsImportStyle.js && eslint scripts && echo 'All checks passed!'
